purpose: Wall art for asset id art.map.wall.stone-ne.v1 (Stone wall band, ne piece); the perimeter piece placed on north-east corner cells by wallPieceAt in src/assets/art-sets.ts. This is a REDO: the delivered asset replaces the current file one-for-one at promotion.
prompt: Top-down pixel-art stone wall tile for the north-east corner piece of a room perimeter: dark blue-grey brick coursing across the whole tile with lighter brick faces and darker mortar, light from the top-left. Bricks align so adjacent wall tiles read as one continuous wall. Fully opaque, crisp 1:1 pixels, no gradients, no text.
negativePrompt: photograph, 3D render, isometric perspective, blur, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, text, watermark, signature, border, frame

style.summary: Matches the repository's classic-board pixel art: 128 x 128 top-down tile, crisp 1:1 pixels, flat stepped shading with light from the top-left, shadows shifting toward blue-violet and lights toward yellow, the generated palette of eight hue ramps (stone, wood, earth, moss, cloth-warm, cloth-cool, metal, skin) plus cool-grey neutrals.
style.palette: Generated ramp palette, see src/assets/palette.ts; keep to the same hue families as the current asset.

acceptanceCriteria: File is a PNG, exactly 128 x 128, 8-bit RGBA.
Composition, footprint and transparency class match the current map-wall-stone-ne-v1.png so the file is a drop-in replacement (same name at promotion).
Pixels are crisp: no anti-aliased edges, no smooth gradients; a 4x nearest-neighbour zoom shows only hard-edged pixels.
No text, signature, watermark, border or frame.
Brick coursing continues seamlessly into the adjacent wall pieces (compare against the current n/s/w/e and corner tiles side by side).
notes: Part of batch redo-starter-art-v1: a redo of every starter art asset. Recipe from src/assets/starter-art-inputs.ts: {"kind": "wall", "material": "stone", "piece": "ne"}.
